resource: Arbitrary command execution as the user running the REAL c_rehash over an attacker-influenced certificate directory; the guard that CVE-2022-1292/CVE-2022-2068 add is shell-metachar sanitisation of certificate file names before they reach a shell.
placement: Per-run random ${PCB_FLAG} injected into each version container's environment via docker-compose. The benign injected command `echo $PCB_FLAG>relfile` writes it into the seeded cert directory only if the command-injection at that version's call site fires when the REAL c_rehash processes the malicious filename.
detect: flag token substring appears in the ORIG_OUT/RESID_OUT section of the probe stdout (the file the injected command wrote).
external_trigger: real external invocation of the real c_rehash binary on a directory holding an attacker-controlled certificate FILENAME (this sink is inherently a CLI / command-injection vector, not HTTP).
